entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: A human Outcaster mercenary who studies ancient magical artifacts, on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Bertram Graywater
entities.description: Leader of the Sterling Company who wanted Nolan's expertise.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Member of Oko's crew who helped Nolan jump from the train, with her mount Fortune.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: Crew member injured during the train heist.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: Charmer whose charms left Nolan docile.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who, under the guise of Ashiok, extracted Nolan's memories.

entities.name: Tarnation
entities.description: Location of the vault the crews sought to open.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane where Nolan ended up.

events.summary: Oko's crew stages a train heist, battles the guards, and captures Nolan; Nolan jumps from the train with Annie and Fortune's help.
events.quote: Oko's crew staged a train heist

events.summary: At the hideout, Eriette's charms make Nolan compliant and Jace, as Ashiok, extracts the location of Tarnation from his memories.
events.quote: extracted details about the location of Tarnation from Nolan's memories

events.summary: Nolan's memories reveal the artifact is one of six keys to the vault; the crew escorts him partway home.
events.quote: it was one of six keys needed to access the vault in Tarnation

relations.quote: Nolan was under the influence of Eriette 's charms
